name: audiogen-cpp
description: ACE-Step music generation in pure C++/ggml. Text-to-music via the ACE-Step pipeline (Qwen3-Embedding text encoder -> ace-lm language model -> DiT diffusion transformer -> Oobleck VAE) behind the same unified Engine API as the tts-cpp and parakeet-cpp engines. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's engines/audiogen/ subfolder (master HEAD 0f832db3, PR #98 merged, QVAC-21921 -- the same PR that grouped tts / parakeet / audiogen under engines/). Runs on CPU and, when built with a ggml-speech GPU feature (Metal on Apple, Vulkan/OpenCL/CUDA elsewhere), on the GPU backend. Consumes the ggml-speech port for the custom GGML_OP_SNAKE and GGML_OP_COL2IM_1D ops the Oobleck VAE decode/encode need (ggml-speech >= 2026-07-22).
